question: Is bond distance steps apart plus one on every knot tree of parity and not-all-equal knots (one size past), how does it compare with the correlation readings on rings and mixed cycles, and does a clause chain lack bonds?

definitions.bond: S with non-full projection and every (|S|-1)-subset projection full
definitions.bond distance: least bond holding both, minus one

public_inputs.reused: TREE-STEPS treelib.py and CUMULANT-DIST cumlib.py, unchanged

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py gates; the clause-chain negative control (P6).

predictions.P3: mixed cycles: bond - 1 = 1, delta_K = k, delta <= 1.1
predictions.P4: rings: parity bond-1 = delta; NAE bond-1 = steps; alternating <= steps
predictions.P5: NAE rings: tau differs from bond-1 by > 0.01 somewhere
predictions.P6: clause chains: no bond holds the ends

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; proof; referee hand-off; report.
